name: Cembra Money Bank AG
summary: Cembra Money Bank AG provides consumer finance products and services in Switzerland. The company offers savings and deposit products; cash and personal loans, and auto loans and leasing products; credit card and invoice financing receivables; leasing services for new and used vehicles, including cars, light commercial vehicles, motorcycles, and caravans, as well as corporate leasing services; and investment securities comprising debt securities.
